name: Make America Great Again
summary: Make America Great Again (MAGA) is the programme of Donald Trump's movement: put the interests of the United States and its citizens first through tariffs, strict immigration enforcement, domestic manufacturing, fossil-fuel production, a strong military and patriotic education. It is hostile to globalism, free-trade deals and open borders, and presents the political establishment as corrupt. Its own sources are firm on trade, immigration, security and sovereignty and say little on much else.
scope: MAGA as a political programme as Cambridge Dictionary defines it (a movement or set of ideas putting the interests of the US and its native-born people first, through tariffs and strict immigration controls) and as set out by its own texts: Trump's 2016 to 2018 speeches and the 2024 Republican platform written 'to Make America Great Again'. It leaves out the separate doctrines of the Claremont, postliberal and national-conservative thinkers that Field and Freedman describe as factions inside the movement, and other writers' views.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The platform promises more police, 'Common Sense Policing' and locking up violent offenders, the opposite of abolishing police and prisons.

anonymous-payments.rationale: The platform says every American has the right to self-custody of digital assets and to 'transact free from Government Surveillance and Control'.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: The platform pledges to dismantle censorship and protect free speech, including online.

central-planning.rationale: Trump's UN address says that wherever socialism or communism was adopted it delivered 'anguish and devastation and failure'.

corporate-influence.rationale: Trump's 2016 speech says big business and major donors back his opponent because they have rigged the system for their benefit.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Trump's speeches speak of moving people 'from welfare to work, from dependence to independence' and getting people 'off of welfare', though no programme cuts are named.

decide-locally.rationale: The platform sends education and abortion law back to the states but also federalises control of Washington DC, cuts funds to sanctuary jurisdictions and mandates federal election rules, so its sources point both ways.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Trump's 2016 convention speech says 'Americanism, not globalism, will be our credo', and his UN speech calls for independent sovereign nations and a reformed UN, not a stronger one.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: The platform commits to strengthening alliances and standing with Israel and the Indo-Pacific nations, so it rejects ending permanent alliances, though it asks allies to pay more.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: The platform pledges to defend the Constitution, the Bill of Rights and fundamental freedoms.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The inaugural says 'whether we are black or brown or white, we all bleed the same red blood of patriots' and enjoy the same freedoms, and the platform calls for equal treatment for all.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The platform slogan is 'DRILL, BABY, DRILL' and it promises to end restrictions on oil, natural gas and coal; Trump's 2018 address says the war on American energy and clean coal has ended.

expand-nuclear.rationale: The platform says Republicans will unleash energy production from all sources, including nuclear.

free-trade.rationale: The platform blames 'blind faith in the siren song of globalism' and unfair trade deals for lost jobs and backs baseline tariffs; Trump calls NAFTA one of the worst deals ever made.

history-own-civilization.rationale: The platform supports schools that teach America's founding principles and Western Civilization.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Trump's 2018 address commits to modernizing and rebuilding the American nuclear arsenal to deter aggression.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: The platform pledges no cuts and no changes to Social Security, keeping the state pension scheme.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Trump's 2018 address says the US must modernize its nuclear arsenal and that a world without nuclear weapons 'is not there yet'.

limit-growth.rationale: The platform's goals are 'the greatest economy in history' and energy dominance, and it ends restrictions on energy production, the opposite of limiting growth for the environment.

limit-guns.rationale: The platform pledges to defend the right to keep and bear arms, and Trump's speeches present the Second Amendment as a right to protect against opponents who would abolish it.

military-superiority.rationale: The platform promises a military 'bigger, better, and stronger than ever' and 'the strongest and most powerful in the world', and Trump's speeches promise to rebuild the depleted military.

more-religion-public.rationale: The platform champions the right to pray and read the Bible in school and a task force on anti-Christian bias, and Trump's 2016 speech pledges to repeal the ban on pulpit politics.

nation-first.rationale: 'America First' is the stated governing principle: every decision on trade, taxes, immigration and foreign affairs is to benefit American workers, and 'it is the right of all nations to put their own interests first'.

national-mission.rationale: Trump's inaugural says 'We do not seek to impose our way of life on anyone', and his 2016 speech abandons the 'failed policy of nation building and regime change'.

open-borders.rationale: The platform calls for sealing the border, completing the wall and the largest deportation programme in American history, and calls open borders a threat to survival.

party-controls-media.rationale: The platform would ban the federal government from colluding to censor speech and says it will protect free speech online.

patriotic-education.rationale: The platform promises 'Authentic Civics Education' to promote love of country, the 1776 Commission and schools that teach America's founding principles.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: The inaugural puts 'total allegiance to the United States' at the bedrock of its politics while making every decision on trade, taxes and immigration serve American workers.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The inaugural says a small group in the capital 'reaped the rewards of government while the people have borne the cost', and the 2016 speech says special interests 'rigged our political and economic system'.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Trump's UN address says success depends on independent nations that 'embrace their sovereignty', and his 2016 speech opposes agreements that put America under foreign rulings.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The platform says politicians 'rejected our History and our Values', and it promises civics education on Western Civilization, love of country and honouring American history; Cambridge defines MAGA as putting the nation's own people first.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: The platform lists 'promoting American Values' abroad and the UN speech backs democracy in Venezuela, while Trump rejects nation building and regime change and any imposition of America's way of life.

public-ownership.rationale: Trump's UN address calls socialism a failed ideology 'faithfully implemented' in the Soviet Union, Cuba and Venezuela, and the platform ends the 'Socialist Green New Deal'.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Trump says decades of record immigration lowered wages and he promises an immigration system that works for Americans, with merit-based admission, an end to chain migration and the visa lottery.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The 2024 platform promises to slash regulations that stifle jobs and reinstate Trump's deregulation, and the 2016 speech calls excessive regulation a job-killer, so it opposes tighter corporate regulation.

religious-exemptions.rationale: The platform says religious liberty protects acting on one's beliefs in everyday life, not only worship.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The platform would ban federal collusion to censor lawful speech and defund censoring institutions.

school-vouchers.rationale: The platform supports universal school choice in every state, and Trump's 2016 speech promises to help parents send children to a safe school of their choice.

separate-church-state.rationale: The platform champions prayer and Bible reading in public schools and says religious liberty covers acting on beliefs in everyday life, which a strict separation would not allow.

state-harmful.rationale: Trump's 2016 speech says 'the most basic duty of government is to defend the lives of its own citizens', treating the state as necessary.

suppress-opposition.rationale: The platform promises to end the weaponization of government against political opponents and to apply the law equally regardless of political affiliation.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: The platform supports baseline tariffs on foreign-made goods to protect American producers, and Trump's 2016 speech promises tariffs against countries that cheat.

traditional-family.rationale: The platform promotes a culture that values the sanctity of marriage and 'the foundational role of families'.

voter-id.rationale: The platform lists voter ID, proof of citizenship, paper ballots and same-day voting among its measures to secure elections.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The platform says legal immigrants must 'never become a drain on Public Resources' and ends taxpayer benefits for illegal immigrants.

missingStatements.text: Governments should favour domestic firms in public contracts.
missingStatements.rationale: The inaugural makes 'Buy American and Hire American' its two rules and the platform strengthens both policies, including a ban on federal contracts for firms that outsource jobs.

quotes.text: We will follow two simple rules: Buy American and Hire American.
Republicans will strengthen Buy American and Hire American Policies, banning companies that outsource jobs from doing business with the Federal Government.

missingStatements.text: Allied countries should pay their fair share of the cost of common defence.
missingStatements.rationale: Trump's 2016 speeches and the 2024 platform both demand that protected allies carry more of the cost.

quotes.text: the countries that we protect, at a massive loss, will be asked to pay their fair share.
Republicans will strengthen Alliances by ensuring that our Allies must meet their obligations to invest in our Common Defense

missingStatements.declined: Accepted almost everywhere, so not contested.

missingStatements.text: A country should build a physical barrier along its border to stop illegal crossings.
missingStatements.rationale: The wall is a standing MAGA promise in the 2016 speech, the 2017 address and the 2024 platform.

quotes.text: We are going to build a great border wall to stop illegal immigration
we will soon begin the construction of a great wall along our southern border.
We must secure our Southern Border by completing the Border Wall that President Trump started.

notes: Themes searched: trade, immigration, security, foreign policy and alliances, courts, elections, education, religion, energy, economy and welfare, speech. Silence is null; answers rest on the 2024 platform and Trump's own 2016-2018 speeches. The platform is the Republican Party's, but it names MAGA as its aim and is cited only for what it states for that programme.
